verdict.rationale: Cart MCP and Checkout MCP are documented UCP protocol calls (create_cart, update_cart, create_checkout, complete_checkout) with JSON-RPC schemas, and a runtime probe confirms a real cart was created keylessly against a live Shopify store via the CLI/protocol. missing for 10: no independent (non-Shopify) hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end checkout completion.
